fields.summary_ko.0: Eli Lilly (LLY) Mounjaro and Zepbound sales accounted for over $16 billion of Q3 total revenue of $24.7 billion with 34% revenue growth, while U.S. net price declined 10%.
fields.summary_ko.1: Full-year 2026 revenue guidance raised from $8.6 billion to $91.5 billion, but mixed composition changes from Medicaid and Medicare expansion and sustained price declines remain key variables for 2027 share price.
